name: CircleLoop
description_en:
CircleLoop is a UK-oriented cloud business phone system with numbers, apps, team ringing, IVR menus, voicemail, recording and call analytics. Users can work through desktop, web or mobile apps, with supported SIP-device provisioning. It can serve a small shared phone operation, but its service terms restrict excessive automated/high-volume dialing and resale; it is not established as an unrestricted bulk-dialer platform.

For an illustrative reception workflow, assign a number to a team or active menu, choose simultaneous or ordered ringing, then configure unanswered and out-of-hours handling. Creating a team without attaching it to a number or route does not make it receive calls. Published monthly plans are £15 or £5 per user plus VAT, with different outbound usage treatment. Conflicting official porting-fee and post-closure recording statements remain unresolved. No account, call, port, payment, integration or export was tested.
description_zh:
CircleLoop 是面向英国业务的云电话系统，提供号码、应用、团队响铃、IVR菜单、语音信箱、录音及电话分析。用户可用桌面、网页或移动应用，并可配置支持的SIP设备。它可服务小型共享电话运营，但服务条款限制过量自动／高量拨号及转售，不能当作无限批量拨号平台。

以假设前台流程为例，将号码分配团队或有效菜单，选择同时或顺序响铃，再配置未接及非营业时间处理。只建团队、不接入号码或路由不能接电话。公开月度方案每人£15或£5加VAT，外呼用量处理不同。官方转号费及关闭后录音资料存在冲突，仍待确认。未测试账户、电话、转号、付款、集成或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure membership,ringing sequence and unanswered/busy handling behind an assigned number or route.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在已分配号码或路由后配置成员、响铃顺序及未接／忙线处理。

core_features.explanation_en: Override standard routes outside selected daily hours with voicemail or an internal/external destination.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在所选每日时间之外覆盖常规路由，转信箱或内部／外部目标。

core_features.explanation_en: Enable recording for individuals or selected account users;download available recordings for retention.
core_features.explanation_zh: 为个人或所选账户用户启用录音，下载可用录音保存。

core_features.explanation_en: Use listed CRM/contact integrations and Slack notifications subject to connector configuration.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按连接器配置使用所列CRM／联系人集成及Slack通知。

en: A UK-focused small business replacing a shared phone line with team ringing and scheduled reception.
A distributed sales/support team needing a business number,call notes/recording and contact-tool integration.
zh: 将共享电话换成团队响铃及定时前台的英国业务小企业。
需要企业号码、电话记录／录音及联系人工具集成的分布式销售／支持团队。
use_cases.basis: Editorial fit,not measured reliability,conversion or independently verified integration performance.

Routing activation prerequisite.en: Team settings take effect only when a number is assigned or the team is used in an active routing configuration such as a Menu.
Routing activation prerequisite.zh: 需分配号码，或在Menu等有效路由配置中使用团队，团队设置才生效。

steps.en: Use a trial number first,confirm call destinations and plan,then check existing-number portability and written fees before moving service.
steps.zh: 先用试用号码，确认目的地及套餐，再核对已有号码可转性及书面费用后迁移服务。

steps.en: Assign users to a team,attach its number or Menu route,and test ringing,busy/no-answer and out-of-hours destinations.
steps.zh: 将用户分配团队，连接号码或Menu路由，并测试响铃、忙线／未接及非营业时间目标。

steps.en: Enable only required recordings,verify access and download them,and establish a retention/exit plan before relying on hosted copies.
steps.zh: 只启用所需录音，确认访问并下载，在依赖托管副本前建立留存／退出方案。

items.en: The Unlimited plan has destination/number-type exclusions and business-use restrictions;it is not global bulk calling.
items.zh: Unlimited有目的地／号码类型例外及企业使用限制，不是全球批量拨号。

items.en: A newly created team receives no calls until connected to an assigned number or active routing configuration.
items.zh: 新团队接入已分配号码或有效路由前不接电话。

items.en: Recording cannot be recovered for calls made before it was enabled.
items.zh: 不能取回启用录音之前电话的录音。

items.en: Public pricing/help says porting is free,but service terms list at least£20/user administration;actual charge unresolved.
items.zh: 公开定价／帮助称转号免费，服务条款却列至少£20／用户管理费，实际费用未解决。

items.en: Recording help says up to12months after closure;terms require download within6months. Confirm actual retention and export before exit.
items.zh: 录音帮助称关闭后最多12个月，条款要求六个月内下载，退出前需确认真实留存及导出。

license.notes_en: Nonexclusive,nontransferable service-use rights for the agreement term;vendor owns service/softwareIP,resale restricted.
license.notes_zh: 协议期内非独占、不可转移服务使用权，厂商拥有服务／软件知识产权，限制转售。

pricing.billing_basis: Peruser/monthplusVAT;PAYG5andUnlimited15 have different outboundusage and extra-number costs. No one normalized all-in cost.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Unlimited每用户每月£15加VAT，含一个英国全国／固话号码、呼入及符合条件的英国／美国／爱尔兰／澳大利亚／新西兰／加拿大外呼，有号码类型及目的地例外。PAYG每用户每月£5加VAT，含一个英国号码及呼入，外呼3p／分钟起。SMS每条4p，额外号码£2起、VIP£3起。七天免卡试用仅有限符合条件英国通话，可混用套餐。转号免费说法与条款5.6每用户£20起冲突，VIP／最低期退出费及真实转号费需书面确认。

faq.question_en: Does creating a Team make it receive calls immediately?
faq.question_zh: 创建Team后会立即接电话吗？
faq.answer_en: Only after its number is assigned or it is used in an active routing configuration,such as a Menu.
faq.answer_zh: 需分配号码，或在Menu等有效路由中使用后才生效。

faq.question_en: Can I rely on twelve months of recording access after leaving?
faq.question_zh: 退出后能依赖十二个月录音访问吗？
faq.answer_en: No verified guarantee was established. Help says up to12months,but terms say download within6months. Confirm and export required recordings before exit.
faq.answer_zh: 未建立已核保证。帮助称最多12个月，条款称六个月内下载；退出前应确认并导出所需录音。

sections.title_en: A shared business phone system with app and device choices
sections.title_zh: 有多种应用及设备选择的共享企业电话
sections.en:
CircleLoop focuses on replacing a business phone system with cloud numbers,team ringing,menus,voicemail,recording and analytics. Its catalogue lists Windows,Mac,web,iOS and Android access as well as provisioned SIP/deskphone/ATA options. This is a hosted service with proprietary use rights,not a self-hosted PBX distribution.

CRM/contact integrations include HubSpot,Capsule,Zoho,Google and Office365,and Slack can receive call/voicemail notifications. Their presence does not establish a specific field mapping,automatic deduplication or complete bidirectional record sync. It fits a shared reception or distributed business-phone workflow more directly than a high-volume outbound floor:the service terms expressly restrict excessive automated dialing,call blasting and resale.
sections.zh:
CircleLoop专注用云号码、团队响铃、菜单、信箱、录音及分析替代企业电话系统。目录列Windows、Mac、网页、iOS及Android访问，以及可配置SIP／桌面电话／ATA。它是有专有使用权的托管服务，不是自托管PBX发行版。

CRM／联系人集成包括HubSpot、Capsule、Zoho、Google及Office365，Slack可接电话／信箱通知。列有集成不证明具体字段映射、自动去重或完整双向同步。相较高量外呼，它更直接适合共享前台或分布式企业电话流程；服务条款明确限制过量自动拨号、群呼及转售。

sections.title_en: Connect the team to a route and define its failure path
sections.title_zh: 将团队接入路由，并定义失败路径
sections.en:
For an illustrative reception number,an administrator creates a Team,adds users and chooses simultaneous ringing,sequential order or turns. Busy and unanswered treatment can lead to voicemail. Team configuration alone is insufficient:the team must have a number assigned or be used in an active route such as a Menu. This prerequisite is a useful first check when a saved team never rings.

Out-of-hours settings override normal call settings during the selected periods. Configure availability per day and choose voicemail,an internal user/team/menu or an external number. The external announce option uses an acceptance step;if declined or unanswered,the normal handling path applies. Test open,closed,busy and unanswered cases with real destinations rather than treating a successful settings save as reception coverage. Emergency use also depends on device,power and network availability under the service terms;no emergency call was tested.
sections.zh:
以假设前台号码为例，管理员建Team、加用户，并选同时响铃、顺序或轮流。忙线及未接可进信箱。仅保存团队配置不够，需分配号码或在Menu等有效路由中使用。这是团队始终不响铃时有用的首查项。

非营业时间设置会在所选时段覆盖普通配置。应按天设可用时间，选择信箱、内部用户／团队／菜单或外部号码。外部announce选项有接受步骤，拒绝或未答时沿常规路径处理。应以真实目标测试营业、关闭、忙线及未接，不能将保存设置成功当作前台覆盖。服务条款下紧急呼叫同样依赖设备、电力及网络，未测试紧急电话。

sections.title_en: Enable recording before the call and export deliberately
sections.title_zh: 通话前启用录音，并主动导出
sections.en:
Recording can be enabled for an individual or,by an owner/administrator,for selected users. It starts with subsequent calls;the guide says recordings cannot be recovered for earlier calls when the option was off. Account-wide review is described through the desktop app,with playback/download of available recordings. Confirm the intended users and access scope rather than assuming every agent can review all colleagues.

Post-closure retention is inconsistent:the recording guide says up to12months,while service clause5.4 requires customers to download/store recordings within6months of termination,after which they are deleted. A separate nonpayment clause has another retention path. Do not promise a twelve-month access window. Export required files while access is available,confirm actual deadlines and verify that the saved audio opens;no complete bulk export or restore was tested.
sections.zh:
可为个人启用录音，账户所有者／管理员也可选用户。它从后续电话开始，指南称关闭期间的早前电话无法补回录音。全部用户复核通过桌面应用说明，可播放／下载已有录音。应确认目标用户及访问范围，不能假设每位客服都能看同事全部录音。

关闭后留存不一致：录音指南称最多12个月，服务条款5.4要求终止后六个月内下载／保存，之后删除；欠费条款还有不同留存路径。不能承诺十二个月访问窗口。应在可访问时导出必需文件，确认实际期限并打开音频验证。未测试完整批量导出或恢复。

sections.title_en: Moving the number can also remove its old connectivity
sections.title_zh: 迁移号码也可能终止原连接
sections.en:
The porting guide says eligibility depends on the number and provider;most UK geographic/mobile and some national/freephone numbers are supported,but not every number. Landline transfer estimates range from a week to a month;mobile estimates are1–2business days. These are vendor estimates,not measured completion guarantees. Do not cancel the old service before transfer completes.

Porting a main landline billing number can end its associated broadband. Porting a mobile number ends the old mobile service including data,so the phone may need replacement connectivity to use CircleLoop away from Wi-Fi. Plan those dependencies before treating number migration as a cosmetic caller-ID change.

Pricing and help advertise free porting,but clause5.6 still describes an administration charge of at least£20per user,agreed in writing. Terms also describe VIP/minimum-commitment exit charges and no porting during a trial. The current applicable price/commitment must be confirmed rather than silently selecting the free statement. No porting paperwork or account change was submitted.
sections.zh:
转号指南称资格取决于号码及运营商，支持多数英国地域／手机及部分全国／免费号码，并非每个号码。固话估计一周至一个月，手机1–2工作日；这是厂商估计，不是实测完成保证。转移完成前不能取消原服务。

转主计费固话可能终止关联宽带，转手机号码会终止原手机服务及数据。因此离开Wi-Fi后使用CircleLoop可能需替代连接。号码迁移前应规划这些依赖，不能当作仅改来显。

定价及帮助宣传免费转号，但条款5.6仍描述至少每用户£20、书面确认的管理费。条款另述VIP／最低承诺退出费及试用期不可转号。需确认当前适用价格及承诺，不能静默选免费说法。未提交转号文件或账户修改。

sections.title_en: Monthly plans still have usage,exceptions and exit conditions
sections.title_zh: 月度套餐仍有用量、例外及退出条件
sections.en:
The public GBP plans are Unlimited£15and PAYG£5per user per month,plus VAT,each including one UK national/landline number. PAYG outbound calls start at3p/min. Unlimited includes eligible domestic and selected international destinations,with explicit number-type exceptions;it does not cover all worldwide calls. SMS is4p/message,additional numbers start at£2and VIP numbers at£3. Users can mix plans. Final cost depends on the actual numbers and destinations.

The seven-day no-card trial permits limited eligible UK calling. Service terms say an unpaid trial suspends at expiry and can be reactivated within30days by adding payment details;it is not a sustained free plan. Paid monthly changes are prorated and settled in the following invoice. Cancellation leaves current-period charges,and the terms describe a seven-day written-termination path,with separate minimum/VIP commitments. General no-refund language has a defined consumer exception;do not describe every situation as refundable or immediate.

CircleLoop fits teams able to define reception routing and preserve required recordings. A buyer needing unrestricted automated campaigns,guaranteed free number migration or a fixed post-exit archive has unresolved evidence. Actual regional processing,connector permissions,full export/restore,UI languages and service reliability were not tested.
sections.zh:
公开GBP套餐为每用户每月Unlimited£15及PAYG£5加VAT，均含一个英国全国／固话号码。PAYG外呼3p／分钟起；Unlimited覆盖合资格国内及所选国际目的地，有明确号码类型例外，不覆盖全球全部电话。SMS每条4p，额外号码£2起，VIP£3起，可混用用户套餐。最终费用取决于真实号码及目的地。

七天免卡试用允许有限符合条件英国通话。服务条款称未付款试用到期暂停，30天内加付款信息可恢复，不是长期免费方案。付费月度修改按比例计入下一发票。取消仍有本期费用，条款描述七天书面终止路径，最低／VIP承诺另计。通常不退款条款有规定消费者例外，不能把所有情形称可退或即时结束。

CircleLoop适合能定义前台路由并保存所需录音的团队。需要无限自动活动、保证免费转号或固定退出后档案的买家仍有未解决证据。实际地区处理、连接器权限、完整导出／恢复、界面语言及可靠性未测试。
